task.title: QA: packaged launch verifiers record the Electron exit and log when the main window never appears
task.objective: Owner go-ahead 2026-11-11 ('Yes, fix them'): verify:ocr-packaged section B and verify:packaged-runtime part C report only 'the main window never appeared' when the packaged process exits early, so the 2026-11-08 Section B failure stayed unconfirmed until a separate diagnostic showed error_code=18 and a fatal exit from the X: share. Add a shared helper that records the launched process's exit code or signal and the last notable Chromium log lines (ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1, diagnostic only) and append that to both failure messages. No acceptance criterion, timeout, GPU, sandbox, security switch, product or packaging change.

acceptance.description: Both launch failure messages name the process exit code (or that it was still running) and the notable log lines; typecheck:scripts PASS; negative control from the X: share shows the error_code=18 exit in the verifier output; no acceptance check weakened.

evidence.observed: 2026-11-11 tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json clean with the new helper and both call sites.

2026-11-11 negative control from the X: share against the unchanged 0.1.54 payload, where the launch is known to fail. Before: part C said only 'packaged main window with the preload bridge never appeared'. After: verify:packaged-runtime parts A/B 10/10, part C fails with 'the launched process exited with code 2147483651 (0x80000003)' plus the error_code=18 lines and 'FATAL ... GPU process isn't usable. Goodbye.'; verify:ocr-packaged precondition and section A 19 passed, section B fails with the same exit code and log lines including 'Renderer process launch-failed'. The gates still fail (no acceptance weakened); the failure now names its cause. Positive behaviour on a local disk was shown separately by the owner-run diagnostic (bridge ready in 14.9 s).
